candidates.legacy_mapping_note: These are original source-field IDs in the target model inventory, retained for curation. No unverified one-to-one mapping between legacy aggregate fields and newly expanded rows is asserted.

claims.value: Source adds a single minimal non-chiral colour-singlet scalar/fermion multiplet to SM; c=1/2 for real scalar or Majorana, c=1 for complex/Dirac. Table 1 gives Y=0 fermion quintuplet and scalar septuplet. Thus LH Weyl [4] with one copy and real scalar [6] with one copy; all SM charges included in primitive normalization.

Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

fields.derivation: Exact highest weights use dynkin-gauge-1. prepare_entry expands identified 4D Dirac/RH fermions into LH conjugates of every factor, and applies one primitive positive charge unit over the entire inventory. Retain source-coordinate row above; scalar-realification equivalence is NOT implemented.
